{{Quote|You can't win. You can kill me&mdash;you can kill a hundred like me&mdash;but your precious Empire is still doomed. If the Rebels don't bring it down, it'll collapse from its own internal rot. And then where will you be, my arrogant young Imperial agent? Your power will be gone, your protection dead or imprisoned. You already don't have any friends.|Lamos Chatoor, to Mara Jade|<ref name="COO" />}}
'''Lamos Chatoor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] who had served in that capacity for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. However, he illegally used his position to further himself and his friends. In 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], he was approached by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who planned on [[Death/Legends|executing]] him for his corruption. Although he attempted to plead and trick his way out of it, Jade killed him with [[Mara Jade's first lightsaber|her lightsaber]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Judgment has been passed, Judge Lamos Chatoor. Have you any final words to say in your defense?''"<br />"''Only that your so-called judgment is insane. Because of a single dubious decision&mdash;''one'' decision&mdash;after twenty years in the judicator's seat, you condemn me to ''death''?|Mara Jade and Lamos Chatoor|<ref name="COO" />}}
[[File:Choices_of_One_PB_art.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Mara Jade, who killed Lamos Chatoor]]
Lamos Chatoor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Judge/Legends|judge]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], he had served the Empire in that capacity for twenty years,<ref name="COO" /> starting in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Service">''[[Choices of One]]'' states that Lamos Chatoor had been in his capacity for twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. As ''Choices of One'' occurs in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', it can be concluded that he began his position as [[Judge/Legends|judge]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> However, for five years of that [[Time/Legends|time]], he had used his position for extortion, [[Thief/Legends|theft]], and influence selling. In the year 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="COOD" /> [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] went to Chatoor's [[Lamos Chatoor's courthouse|courthouse]] in order to [[Death/Legends|execute]] him for the crimes he had committed. The judge first tried to persuade her that he did not deserve to die, and, when that did not work, he proceeded to plead for her to not execute him.<ref name="COO" />

However, his pleading was only a stalling tactic so that two men could arrive and attack Jade. They did so, but Jade was ready for them and killed them when she [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|redirected]] their own [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts back at them with [[Mara Jade's first lightsaber|her lightsaber]]. During the hassle, Chatoor attempted to make a grab for Jade's dropped [[Weapon/Legends|blaster]], but she caught him in time, holding him at bay with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The judge then began to again plead for his life, stating that Jade had no friends, and that he was willing to be one to her. However, Jade responded by passing her lightsaber through his neck, killing him.<ref name="COO" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But I can help you. ''I'' can be your friend. Spare my life&mdash;leave me in my position here&mdash;and I can create a refuge where you'll be safe when it all falls apart around you&mdash;|Lamos Chatoor's last words, to Mara Jade|<ref name="COO" />}}
Lamos Chatoor was an overweight male who had served as an Imperial judge for twenty years<ref name="COO" /> by 0 ABY.<ref name="COOD" /> He was a corrupt individual and used his position as a judge to better himself, his friends, and his supporters. Chatoor also had made deals that had defrauded the Empire and its citizens. When faced with death, he attempted to plead, persuade, and trick Mara Jade. As Jade had a blaster held to his head, his face turned [[Color/Legends|red]] in color, and he began sweating excessively. Later, when Jade held a lightsaber to his throat, his face turned white and contorted. Although he claimed to be innocent, he tried to shoot Jade in the back, and Jade stated that an innocent person would not shoot an Imperial agent in the back.<ref name="COO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lamos Chatoor appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="COO" />
